required_service.section_rule: Every optional section must carry status=READY before customer runtime renders it as real data.
required_service.unknown_rule: If command result is uncertain, customer runtime queries snapshot and never blindly retries.
required_service.tenant_rule: snapshot.tenant_id must equal current /me project tenant.
required_service.action_rule: Each write action requires snapshot.actions[type]===true plus existing OWNER/EDITOR role.
required_service.approval_rule: Backend must expose the authoritative approval state for any action that requires approval; frontend must not invent approval.

known_non_authoritative_sources: scripts/task_supervisor_runtime.py (supervision runtime, no customer GEO authority)
